response.sql: WITH transaction_stats AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), average_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS transactions_per_account FROM trans) SELECT ts.account_id, ts.average_amount, ts.transaction_count, ts.transaction_count / ac.transactions_per_account AS count_ratio FROM transaction_stats AS ts CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac ORDER BY count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
